bounce.program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (fnz (lambda (r) (find (lambda (c) (!= (at g r c) 0)) (range 0 w))))
                (result (find (lambda (pair) pair)
                              (for/list ((p (range 1 h)))
                                (let* ((f0 (fnz 0))
                                       (fp (fnz p)))
                                  (and
                                    (and f0 fp)
                                    (let* ((s (- fp f0)))
                                      (and
                                        (for/and ((r (range 0 (- h p))))
                                                 (for/and ((c (range 0 w)))
                                                          (let* ((sc (+ c s)))
                                                            (if (and (>= sc 0) (< sc w))
                                                                (= (at g r c)
                                                                   (at g (+ r p) sc))
                                                                (zero? (at g r c))))))
                                        (list p s))))))))
                (period (if result (first result) h))
                (shift (if result (second result) 0))
                (base-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                     (for/or ((r (range 0 period)))
                                       (!= (at g r c) 0)))
                                   (range 0 w)))
                (left (if (null? base-cols) 0 (apply min base-cols)))
                (right (if (null? base-cols) 0 (apply max base-cols)))
                (span (- w (+ 1 (- right left)))))
           (build-grid w
                       w
                       (r c)
                       (let* ((raw (+ left (* shift (quotient r period))))
                              (phase (if (> span 0) (modulo raw (* 2 span)) 0))
                              (anchor (if (> span 0) (min phase (- (* 2 span) phase)) left))
                              (offset (- anchor left))
                              (src-c (- c offset)))
                         (if (and (>= src-c 0) (< src-c w))
                             (at g (remainder r period) src-c)
                             0))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (fnz (lambda (r) (find (lambda (c) (!= (at g r c) 0)) (range 0 w))))
                (result (find (lambda (pair) pair)
                              (for/list ((p (range 1 h)))
                                (let* ((f0 (fnz 0))
                                       (fp (fnz p)))
                                  (and
                                    (and f0 fp)
                                    (let* ((s (- fp f0)))
                                      (and
                                        (for/and ((r (range 0 (- h p))))
                                                 (for/and ((c (range 0 w)))
                                                          (let* ((sc (+ c s)))
                                                            (if (and (>= sc 0) (< sc w))
                                                                (= (at g r c)
                                                                   (at g (+ r p) sc))
                                                                (zero? (at g r c))))))
                                        (list p s))))))))
                (period (if result (first result) h))
                (shift (if result (second result) 0))
                (use-period period)
                (base-cols (filter (lambda (cc)
                                     (for/or ((rr (range 0 use-period)))
                                       (!= (at g rr cc) 0)))
                                   (range 0 w)))
                (left (if (null? base-cols) 0 (apply min base-cols)))
                (right (if (null? base-cols) 0 (apply max base-cols)))
                (span (- w (+ 1 (- right left))))
                (clamped-anchors
                  (for/list ((q (range 0 w)))
                    (first
                      (foldl (lambda (ignored state)
                               (let* ((pos (first state))
                                      (vel (second state))
                                      (next (+ pos vel)))
                                 (cond ((zero? span) (list left 0))
                                       ((>= next span) (list span (- (abs vel))))
                                       ((<= next 0) (list 0 (abs vel)))
                                       (else (list next vel)))))
                             (list left shift) (range 0 q))))))
           (build-grid w w (r c)
             (if (< r h)
                 (at g r c)
                 (let* ((source-row (modulo (- r h) use-period))
                        (block (quotient r use-period))
                        (local-cols base-cols)
                        (local-left (if (null? local-cols) 0 (apply min local-cols)))
                        (local-right (if (null? local-cols) 0 (apply max local-cols)))
                        (local-span (- w (+ 1 (- local-right local-left))))
                        (raw (+ local-left (* shift block)))
                        (wave (if (> local-span 0) (modulo raw (* 2 local-span)) 0))
                        (anchor (if (> local-span 0) (min wave (- (* 2 local-span) wave)) local-left))
                        (src-c (- c (- anchor local-left))))
                   (if (and (>= src-c 0) (< src-c w))
                       (at g source-row src-c)
                       0)))))))
